info.title: Jobsence Job Portal - Complete API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for Jobsence Job Portal, supporting Mobile Apps (iOS/Android) and Web. Includes Authentication, Candidate & Employer Portals, Payments, Subscriptions, AI Job Matching, and Real-time Communications.

post.description: Flutter employer registration endpoint matching the web employer form. First call /api/v1/send-email-otp with purpose=register_employer and role=employer, then submit this payload with email_otp.

gstin.description: Optional GSTIN. Must be valid if provided.

email_otp.description: 6 digit OTP sent to email using purpose register_employer

400.description: Registration failed or email already exists

get.description: Returns a paginated list of jobs the candidate has applied for, including job and company details.
Alias for /api/v1/candidate/applications. Returns a list of jobs the candidate has applied for.

get.summary: Get account settings and notification preferences

get.description: Alias for /api/v1/candidate/premium/plans. Returns available premium/upgrade plans for candidates.

plan_id.description: Use an id returned by GET /api/v1/candidate/premium/plans. Employer plan ids are not accepted.

post.description: Verifies payment and activates candidate premium. order_id and payment_id are required.

order_id.description: Gateway order id. For Razorpay this may also be sent as razorpay_order_id.

payment_id.description: Internal subscription payment id returned by initiate.

signature.description: Gateway signature. For Razorpay this may also be sent as razorpay_signature.

get.description: Mobile billing overview using the same employer billing data as the website: current plan, subscription, balance due, upcoming payment, last payment, recent transactions and alerts.
Returns combined subscription and add-on transactions with the same filters and summary used by the website transactions page.
Returns subscription payment invoices using the same filters as the website invoices page.
Returns current subscription, current plan, usage, recent subscription payments and alerts for the mobile subscription dashboard.
Returns saved card/UPI payment methods and the default payment method.
Returns billing profile, subscription, current plan and payment methods for mobile billing settings.
Returns complete employer company details for mobile apps, including account, company, GST/tax, address, logo, banner, KYC documents, profile completion, job stats, subscription and last payment.
Returns all jobs posted by the authenticated employer. Each job includes saved company/contact fields, locations, location_display and publish status.

post.description: Create and publish a job for the authenticated employer. Location data is saved in both jobs.locations and job_locations for map/search support.

description.example: Build and maintain Flutter mobile applications.

job_address.example: Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India

get.description: Returns counts for total, upcoming, today, this week, completed, and cancelled interviews.
Returns a paginated list of interviews for the employer with optional filters.
Returns employer account, preferences, and basic company information.

put.description: Update email, phone, and additional mobile number.
Update company name, website, industry, and size.

post.description: Candidates may send employer_id (employers.id) or user_id (employer users.id). Employers may send candidate_id (candidates.id), candidate_user_id, or user_id.

user_id.description: Other user's users.id. For candidates this is employer user_id; for employers this is candidate user_id.

employer_id.description: Use when the authenticated user is a candidate.

candidate_id.description: Use when the authenticated user is an employer.

candidate_user_id.description: Use when the authenticated user is an employer.

initial_message.example: Hello, I would like to discuss this opportunity.

422.description: Required participant id missing or invalid

get.description: Returns jobs matched to the candidate's profile using the AI engine.

post.description: Creates an employment verification record for HR background checks.

get.description: Returns approved reviews for a company.

post.description: Creates a company review. Candidate login required. Use company_id when available; employer_id is accepted and mapped to company_id.

review_text.example: Good working culture and helpful management.

get.description: Returns reviews created by the authenticated user.

put.description: Updates a review owned by the authenticated user. Review can be edited within 30 days.

review_text.example: Updated review text with minimum required length.

delete.description: Deletes a review owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns review count, average rating, and rating distribution for a company.
Returns countries from the database. Each item includes id, name, slug and code when known.
Returns all states, or states filtered by country. Use country_id for exact filtering, or country/country_code for name/code filtering.
Returns all cities, or cities filtered by state and country. Use state_id for exact filtering, or state name/slug.
